name: Banana oat muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease 12 muffin cups.
Mix the banana, egg, milk and oil.
Fold in the flour, oats, baking powder and cinnamon without overmixing.
Divide into the cups and bake for 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Fluffy pancakes
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk and oil.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, about 2 minutes per side.
Serve in finger-width strips for the youngest children.

name: Lentil and carrot patties
steps: Coarsely mash the lentils with a fork.
Mix with the grated carrot, egg, breadcrumbs and garlic.
Shape into flat, firmly packed patties.
Brown for 3 to 4 minutes per side in the oil.

name: Sweet potato and chicken purée
steps: Cook the sweet potato and chicken in the broth until tender.
Purée with the cooking liquid and the oil.
Adjust the texture to the child's age: smooth, mashed or in pieces.

name: Apple cinnamon oatmeal
steps: Bring the milk to a simmer with the grated apple.
Add the oats and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Let cool slightly — the texture thickens as it cools.

name: Date energy bites
steps: Blend the dates into a paste in a food processor.
Add the peanut butter, oats, chia and vanilla, then pulse.
Roll into small balls and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

name: Pasta in rosé sauce with chicken
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the diced chicken.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream off the heat.
Toss with the cooked pasta, cut short for young children.

name: Baked fish nuggets
steps: Finely chop the raw fish and the onion.
Mix with the egg and half the breadcrumbs.
Shape into nuggets and roll them in the remaining breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200 °C for 15 minutes, turning halfway through.
